title: Sharma Ji Ka Beta
text:
Mummy: Sharma ji ka beta topper aa gaya.
Main: Mummy, uske paas bhi to Sharma ji jaise papa hain.
Mummy: Matlab?
Main: Matlab team ka fark hai, player ka nahi. 🏆

title: Ghar ka Dabba
text:
Indian ghar ka rule:
Amul ke dabbe me ghee nahi hoga,
ice cream ke dabbe me dal hogi,
aur biscuit ke dabbe me sui-dhaga. 🧵

title: Mehmaan Aane Wale Hain
text:
Mummy: Mehmaan aa rahe hain, ghar saaf karo.
Main: Poora ghar?
Mummy: Nahi, bas wo jitna dekh sakte hain.
Yahi hai desi optimization. 🧹

title: Papa aur Remote
text:
Papa TV dekhte-dekhte so jaate hain.
Remote lene ki koshish karo toh turant jaag jaate hain:
"Main dekh raha tha!"
Aankh band karke dekhne ki technology sirf papa ke paas hai. 📺

title: Shaadi Wale Uncle
text:
Har shaadi me ek uncle hota hai
jo kisi ko nahi jaanta,
sabse zyada khaata hai,
aur photo me sabse aage khada hota hai. 🤵

title: Fridge ki Bottle
text:
Thanda paani peene ke liye fridge khola.
Bottle me exactly ek ghoont bacha tha,
aur wapas fridge me rakh diya gaya tha.
Ghar me detective banna padta hai. 🚰

title: Nani ka Nuskha
text:
Bukhar? Haldi wala doodh.
Khansi? Haldi wala doodh.
Exam me fail? Haldi wala doodh.
Nani ke paas ek hi API hai, par uptime 100%. 🥛

title: Polythene ka Collection
text:
Har Indian ghar me ek polythene hoti hai
jisme 40 aur polythene bhari hoti hain.
Wo nahi kaam aati —
par phenk bhi nahi sakte. 🛍️

title: Window Seat
text:
Train me window seat ke liye jitni planning hoti hai,
utni planning me toh train hi khareed sakte the. 🚆

title: Mummy ka Radar
text:
Mummy ko pata chal jaata hai ki humne kya toda hai,
kab toda hai, aur kahan chhupaya hai.
ISRO ko mummy se training leni chahiye. 🛰️

title: Bijli Gayi
text:
Bijli jaate hi poora mohalla ek saath "ohhhh" bolta hai.
Aur bijli aate hi taali bajti hai.
Is se badi community feeling kahin nahi milti. 💡

title: Biscuit ka Risk
text:
Chai me biscuit dubane ka sahi time
sirf 1.5 second hota hai.
Uske baad biscuit chai ka hissa ban jaata hai,
aur dukh hamara. 🍪

title: Ghar ka Pen
text:
Ghar me pen tab tak milta hai jab tak zarurat na ho.
Form bharna ho toh poora ghar khali,
aur pen sirf wo milta hai jo chalta nahi. 🖊️

title: Padosi ka WiFi
text:
Padosi ka WiFi password guess karna
ek national sport hona chahiye.
Medal na sahi, izzat toh milti hai. 📡

title: Shortcut
text:
Main: Bhaiya, shortcut se chaliye.
Driver: Bilkul saab.
40 minute baad wahi chowk.
Shortcut sirf naam ka tha, raasta emotional tha. 🛵

title: Sunday ka Plan
text:
Saturday raat: kal poora din productive hoga.
Sunday subah 11 baje: neend.
Sunday shaam 6 baje: "Sunday toh nikal gaya."
Har hafte same script, same actor. 🗓️
